title: VLS project configuration
description: Per-project settings of the V Language Server, read from a project's vls.json.

defines.description: Compile-time defines a check runs with: ["-d", "flag"] or ["-dflag"].

inlayHints.description: Whether the editor shows inlay type and parameter hints in this project.

diagnostics.description: Whether the editor runs compile-time diagnostics for this project's files.

coverageDirectory.description: A coverage directory a test run recorded with `v -coverage`. It is what the generate-test code actions read to tell which functions are untested.
